bullets.text: Cyclonic storm Murasu uprooted twelve trees and damaged properties in Chennai, and the office should monitor relief operations closely.
Sun News issued a heavy rain alert for Chennai and Thiruvallur, and the office must track weather updates.
Owners protested by parking sewage vehicles at the Gummidipoondi block development office, and the district team should watch local developments.
Greater Chennai Corporation removed ad skins from seventy-three illegal hoardings while steel structures remain, and the team should monitor safety.
Vultr plans to build one gigawatt of AI capacity in Chennai by 2029, and the portfolio team should support this infrastructure expansion.
Corning expanded Pune optical manufacturing and its Chennai cover-glass plant began operations, and the office should track manufacturing growth.
Global sell-offs in AI stocks focus attention on Indian IT services, and the ministry should watch market trends.

stories.title: Murasu uproots 12 trees, damages houses, vehicles in Chennai
takeaways: Heavy rains from cyclonic storm Murasu uprooted 12 trees and damaged houses and vehicles across Chennai.
Severe waterlogging on roads requires immediate clearance and monitoring across low-lying constituencies like Velachery.
